about_the_game:
When the world of numen9 shattered, its oceans rose into the sky and left nine fractured realms hanging above an exposed molten core known as the Inner Sun. Crystal wastelands burn with radiation. Strange creatures roam the ruins. And somewhere beyond the sky-seas, Rin D’Lorah’s father has vanished.

You are Rin, a young woman pulled into a planetary mystery far greater than herself. Across nine fully voiced episodes, you will explore a broken sci-fi world, uncover the truth behind numen9’s collapse, and shape Rin into the person she becomes. Every dialogue choice, every discovery, and every risk you take will leave its mark — on Rin, on the people around her, and on the fate of the world itself.

This is a story-driven isometric adventure where character matters as much as plot. Your decisions build Rin across five core traits: Intelligence, Humor, Courage, Compassion, and Luck. Push too hard in one direction and you may survive — but lose yourself in the process. In Sky of Tides, true power comes not from min-maxing, but from balance.

Talk to unforgettable characters who have their own agendas, opinions, and tempers. Search ancient locations for hidden objects and long-buried truths. Unlock powerful suits that enhance your evolving stats and open new ways to face the journey ahead. Beneath its vibrant science-fantasy world lies a branching narrative with different endings, where your version of Rin determines which future numen9 receives.

And if you achieve true balance, the story goes even further: unlock the game’s true ending and gain access to Sky of Tides: Atla, a five-episode animated series set in the same universe, watchable directly inside the game.

Key Features

  • A branching choice-driven adventure with multiplay endings shaped by your decisions and character growth

  • A unique balance-based progression system built around 5 personality stats

  • Explore a fractured sci-fi world from an isometric perspective

  • Discover hidden objects, ancient secrets, and the truth behind numen9’s fall

  • Unlock customization suits that boost and reshape Rin’s abilities

  • Full English voice acting featuring acclaimed actors and creators

  • Unlock a bonus animated series inside the game by reaching the true ending

If you love choice-heavy narrative games, character-driven mysteries, and worlds that reward curiosity, Sky of Tides invites you to lose yourself in a beautiful collapse — and decide what rises from it.

  • OS *: Windows 7 (64 bit)
  • Processor: i7 2600k
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Sky of Tides is a choice-driven isometric sci-fi adventure following Rin D’Lorah as she searches for her missing father in a shattered world where oceans float in the sky. Shape her through decisions, balance who she is becoming, and uncover a mystery where every choice quietly rewrites the future.
